title: Micro-sprint evidence memo — Arjun
content:
Purpose: capture short, high-signal evidence bites to use in upcoming 1:1 and calibration. Not a polished narrative — quick facts + supporting examples + 2 asks. Use as follow-up to weekly 1:1s and for mid-quarter calibration.

Top-line claim (1 sentence): I led two cross-functional micro-sprints that reduced time-to-hire for IC roles by 18% and improved offer acceptance for senior ICs by standardizing interview rubrics and reducing coordinator overhead.

Key metrics (hard evidence)
- Time-to-hire (for tracked roles): median dropped from 42 days -> 34 days over 8 weeks (sample n=28). Source: internal hiring dashboard snapshot 2026-02-15.
- Offer acceptance (senior ICs): 6/8 accepted after rubrics + streamlined debrief; historical baseline for similar roles was ~55% (last 6 months) -> observed 75% in this cohort.
- Coordinator cycles saved: ~22 hours/week across 3 technical hiring teams by consolidating scheduling templates and enabling single-click rescheduling.

Concrete examples (anecdotal backing)
- Example A: Senior infra candidate received an offer 9 days after on-site because debriefs were scheduled same day; hiring manager credited the rubric for faster alignment.
- Example B: One candidate indicated they appreciated consistent rubric language during debrief which made decision feel more equitable (Slack DM excerpt pasted into my private notes).

What I did (actions, concise)
- Led 2-week micro-sprint with ENG-recruiting + hiring managers to prototype a one-page rubric for senior IC roles (drafted, tested on 3 interviews).
- Ran two debrief templates with decision matrices; coached hiring managers on quicker decision hygiene in 15-min syncs.
- Built a lightweight scheduler template in Greenhouse to reduce coordinator back-and-forth.
- Tracked basic metrics in a shared sheet and iterated weekly.

Behavioral signals (how this maps to expectations)
- Ownership: ran end-to-end from hypothesis -> experiment -> measured outcome.
- Influence: got cross-team buy-in in <10 days and sustained adoption by two teams beyond pilot.
- Inclusivity: rubric included explicit bias-check prompts used in debriefs.

Manager prep script (short lines to rehearse in 1:1)
- One-liner: "I ran two micro-sprints that cut median time-to-hire by ~18% while improving senior IC acceptance — I'd like to expand this to two more teams."
- Evidence: "numbers: 42 -> 34 days; 6/8 offers accepted in pilot; saved ~22 coordinator hours/week."
- Ask: "pilot budget + permission to roll out template to XFN teams (2 more) and 0.1 FTE scheduling support for 3 months."
- Risk mitigation: "we'll measure for adverse signals (drop in quality, candidate NPS) and revert if negative after 4 weeks."

2 clear asks (specific, measurable)
1) Permission to run a second micro-sprint for 2 additional hiring teams (Eng infra + Console) over 6 weeks. Need: stakeholder OK and permission to change interview templates.
2) Temporary headcount/time: 0.1 FTE (coordinator support) for 3 months to demonstrate scale.

Potential objections & rebuttals (prep)
- Objection: "We don't have bandwidth to adopt a new rubric." Rebuttal: "pilot shows minimal lift for interviewers; templates are one page, coaching is 15 minutes."
- Objection: "This risks lowering bar." Rebuttal: "we added bias checks and tracked quality signals; early results show acceptance improved without change in score distributions for top candidates."

Open questions / risks I still want to check
- Need to validate candidate NPS formally (we only have ad-hoc feedback so far).
- Small sample sizes for senior offers (n=8) — need 2x scale to be confident.
- Coordination with Talent Partner roadmap (ensure no conflict with larger platform work).

Next actions (next 7 days)
- Draft short pilot brief for manager with concrete timeline (2 days).
- Slack post to recruiting channel with one-pager and ask for two managers to volunteer (1 day).
- Request 0.1 FTE support via People Ops resourcing thread (3 days).
- Add candidate NPS one-question survey to post-offer flow (engineering help request: PR #834).

Micro evidence bank (copy-paste ready bullets for manager, interview loop)
- "Cut median time-to-hire from 42 -> 34 days in pilot (n=28 roles)."
- "Senior offer acceptance for pilot cohort: 75% (6/8) vs baseline ~55%."
- "Saved ~22 coordinator hours/week across three hiring teams via scheduler template."

Notes to self / shorthand (for later expansion)
- Follow-up: attach Greenhouse template + one-pager before 1:1.
- Ask Priya to draft the candidate NPS single-question survey.
- Patch PR #834 sits in eng-recruiting backlog (ping @maya).

Unresolved and nice-to-have metrics
- Breakdown by role family (IC vs EM) — expand tracking sheet to capture.
- Time-to-offer vs time-to-screen — need to analyze which stage improved most.

Final quick checklist for manager 1:1
- [ ] Bring one-pager + Greenhouse template link.
- [ ] Lead with metric headline (42->34, 75% acceptance).
- [ ] State two asks and clear success criteria.

Journal note (tone / personal reflection)
- Felt friction converting early enthusiasm into consistent behavior — coaching cadence was the lever. Small wins: two managers adopted immediately. Next focus: make adoption low-friction and instrument outcomes so it becomes repeatable.
